summary: Frontend-only smoke + integration test for the Chandan Gowda AH cyberpunk portfolio. All 9 review requirements were verified across desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports. All data-testid selectors found, all sections render correctly, all interactive behaviors (nav anchor-scroll, mobile menu, project filters, contact links, Three.js scene, animated counters) work as expected. Zero console errors. Two non-blocking console warnings present (THREE.Clock deprecation from three.js internals).
critical_code_review_comments: three.js shows two 'THREE.Clock: This module has been deprecated. Please use THREE.Timer instead.' warnings on every page load — sourced from inside three.js itself, not the app code. Non-blocking but consider upgrading/pinning three to a version that no longer emits this, or suppressing in HeroScene if future versions remove THREE.Clock.

Hero name renders as 'CHANDANGOWDA.AH' because the
between CHANDAN and GOWDA is not preserved in textContent. The visual layout (two lines + .AH suffix) is correct; only the text-content readout is concatenated. No functional issue, just noting for any future a11y/SEO scraping work.

Custom cursor (cursor: none) is enabled site-wide on non-touch devices. Playwright clicks worked fine with force=True, but anyone using keyboard/assistive tech with a hidden cursor may have orientation issues — consider a prefers-reduced-motion / accessibility opt-out toggle (not required, just a quality note).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully functional. URL: https://engineer-portfolio-71.preview.emergentagent.com. All review items verified: hero (name + typewriter role 'GenAI Data Engineer · LLM Architect · RAG Specialist' + Three.js canvas), sticky nav with 5 desktop links scrolling to sections, mobile hamburger + 5 mobile-nav-links auto-closing on click, 5 stat counters animate to 3+/10+/7/10+/4, 2 skill groups with 7 total skill-card-* cells, 13 project cards with filter counts All(13)/AI Agents(8)/Data Eng(3)/Full Stack(2) all reducing correctly, certs marquee (14 imgs = 7 doubled), experience-0 (Accion Labs, Sep 2024–Present) and experience-1 (Koantek, Jun 2023–Aug 2024) with correct bullets, contact cards with target=_blank LinkedIn + mailto + tel hrefs all correct, contact-tags visible. No console errors. Only 2 non-blocking three.js deprecation warnings.
